about.values.localFirst.title: Local-First
about.values.localFirst.desc: We prioritize India's underserved towns and villages, bringing them the same digital convenience that metros enjoy.
about.values.multilingual.title: Multilingual by Design
about.values.multilingual.desc: Every interface, every interaction — designed to work in 7 Indian languages from day one.
about.values.community.title: Community Empowerment
about.values.community.desc: We create income opportunities for local hosts, families, and skilled workers in their own neighborhoods.
about.values.tourism.title: Tourism Growth
about.values.tourism.desc: We're helping India's smaller destinations become accessible, bookable, and discoverable.
about.values.trust.title: Trust & Inclusion
about.values.trust.desc: Every listing and provider is verified. Every user is valued, regardless of their tech experience.
about.values.instant.title: Instant & Simple
about.values.instant.desc: From search to booking, everything is designed to be fast, clear, and frictionless.
about.hero.subtitle: IstaSeva exists to bring modern booking and service access to India's underserved towns and villages. We believe every small town deserves the same digital convenience, trust, and opportunity that major cities have.
about.story.title: Our Story
about.story.p1: India is a country of 640,000+ villages and thousands of small towns. Yet, when it comes to travel, booking, and local services, most digital platforms focus only on metros and Tier 1 cities.
about.story.p2: We saw a gap — and an opportunity. Millions of travelers visit temple towns, heritage sites, family hometowns, and rural destinations every year. They struggle to find clean, affordable stays and reliable local help. Meanwhile, local hotel owners, families with spare rooms, and skilled workers have no easy way to reach these travelers.
about.story.p3: IstaSeva bridges this gap. We combine hotel booking, homestay booking, and instant local services into one unified, multilingual platform — purpose-built for India beyond the metros.
about.story.p4: Our vision is simple: whether you need a room in Hampi, a homestay in Alleppey, or a plumber in Kumbakonam, IstaSeva can help you — instantly, in your language, with trust.
about.mission.title: Join Our Mission
about.mission.desc: We're a passionate team of builders, designers, and dreamers committed to digital inclusion and local empowerment. If you share our vision for making India's small towns more accessible and connected, we'd love to hear from you.

privacyPanel.confirmBody: Deletion runs after a 48-hour grace period — until then your account keeps working and you can cancel from this page. Afterwards your profile, listings, messages and personal data are permanently removed and you are signed out everywhere. Records required by tax law (completed bookings and payments) are kept with your personal details removed. Upcoming bookings are NOT cancelled automatically — cancel them first for a refund.
